string-array.name: help_instruction
string-array.item:
"1. Click the packs button to show the packs you've created or have access to
2. Click the edit button to delete a card in the current pack
3. Click the plus symbol to create a new pack
4. Click the play button to play the card!;
5. Click the paint brush to change the colour palette of your cards
6. Click the information symbol to get to this screen
7. Click the settings button to access the settings of the app
8. Click the share button to upload your pack to Dropbox and share with others, or install a pack by code"
"1. Click the card you want to edit\n2. Click anywhere in the card to edit the text\n3. Click the plus symbol to add a new card to your current pack"

"1. You can set an background image for each question and answer in a card
2. You can click on the template button to change the template
3. You can record sounds for each card
4. Click to select an image/video from library, or insert a YouTube video linkage
5. Switch to question/answer part of a card"
"When you are editing you can change the alignment, size, colour of the text and even insert symbols by clicking these buttons;"
